

{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Earth Rabbit|kanji=己卯|romaji=tsuchinoto usagi|onyomi=kibō|p=jǐmǎo|w=chi-mao|mi=t͡ɕi³⁵ mɑʊ̯²¹|y=gei2 maau5|j=gei2 maau5|ci=kei maːu̯|mc=kɨj maw|oc-bs=kɯʔ maw}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Earth Rabbit''' (己卯, ''tsuchinoto usagi''; onyomi ''kibō'') is the 16th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 16th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Earth Tiger|ja|戊寅}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Metal Dragon|ja|庚辰}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''己'' is Yin Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''卯'' (Rabbit) is Yin Wood; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Earth Rabbit (己卯)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): jǐmǎo
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gei2 maau5
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: tsuchinoto-usagi
*** On'yomi: kibō
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gimyo (기묘)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Kỷ Mão

==Months of Yin Earth Rabbit==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 0 or 5 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kanoe (庚)|ja|庚|lt=Kanoe (庚)|2=ja|3=庚|4=zh|5=庚|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Kinoto (乙)|ja|乙|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otsu}}), the month of {{ill|February|en|February|qid=Q109|lt=February}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)}} of {{ill|Yin Earth Rabbit|ja|己卯|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kibou|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Jingzhe|en|Jingzhe|qid=Q1306596|lt=Awakening of Insects}} until the day before {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming}}) as applicable.
==Days of Yin Earth Rabbit==
The {{ill|Senjitsu|ja|選日|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/selected day}} for {{ill|Yin Earth Rabbit|ja|己卯|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kibou|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is as follows.
=== Selected Day (選日) ===
The day of {{ill|Yin Earth Rabbit|ja|己卯|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kibou|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is the 2nd day of {{ill|Tsuchi (Japanese term)|ja|犯土|lt=Small Earth|lt_ja=小土|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Small Earth|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}}.
